output.summary: A fast-growing evergreen shrub or small tree native to Macaronesia—the Azores, Madeira and Canary Islands. Its roots host bacteria that enable nitrogen fixation, and it has become invasive in Hawaii, Australia and New Zealand. The sweet, edible fruits are slightly astringent and can stain skin and the mouth blue.
output.edibilityNote: Sweet fruits are edible but little appreciated because they are astringent and roughen the tongue; they have also been made into wine.
